shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: The strong base on which a building is built.

shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: Workers checked the foundation before building the walls.

records.editorial_risk: Construction base; Oxford building-topic c1 tag on dictionary page is not the wordlist CEFR level; distinguish foundations of a building from a charitable foundation.

dictionary_sense_lead.editorial_interpretation: Building foundations are usually plural and physically underground; separate from the abstract basis and charity senses.
